results.title: Umbrel is rated "Excellent" with 4.4 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
Considering 47 reviews, reviewers overwhelmingly had a great experience with this company. Consumers frequently praise the remarkably clean interface, smooth setup process, and powerful hardware performance that handles daily hosting needs effortlessly. People often mention that the support team is exceptionally helpful, highly knowledgeable, and extremely quick to resolve various technical challe nges. However, some customers also noted frustrating issues with unresponsive customer service, delayed communication, and unexpected shipping discrepancies. A few people also mentioned that devices can occasionally disconnect from networks or require tedious manual reconfiguration after software updates. Others felt that maintaining older applications can sometimes present security risks [...] Gailė rocks! Backstory - I have a small Raspberry 5 and run AxeBCH and AxeDGB mining nodes on it. I apply the updates as they come along to apps and OS... made the upgrade from Umbrel 1.7.4 to 2.0 and my miner nodes just flat died! After looking on line to other miners, I saw that there was some changes to 2.0 that made them non-op and there was no planned updates coming! Ugh! I was prepared to wipe it all out, reinstalll 1.7.4 and start over! Ugh! Last ditch effort before I wiped it all out, I hit up Umbrel for a bit of help with the AxeBCH app. The AI bot did fine but didn't fix it... Passed a trouble ticket on and in less than 12 hrs I had a reply! Well, that's not been my typical experience with support on other sites, so hope was slightly restored. Nice email with some stuff to do [...] Image 41: Rated 5 out of 5 stars

## After figuring out from user error how…
After figuring out from user error how to install Umbrel OS to my mini pc, I love the interface. It is sleek and beyond user friendly. The apps in the App Store are fantastic and if you have issues, the community chat plus Ai really helps you figure out the issue. One issue I had was my machine, if internet went down, I would have to manually log in using a sudo command to get the device to connect to the wifi. The Ai sent a ticket and Aiden jumped on helping all the way until the new Beta 2 resolved issue. Very knowledgeable and helpful team. Once storage starts to go back down in pricing, I will purchase an Umbrel Pro for an extension to what I am using. I would highly recommend the OS and the devices.

results.title: Umbrel Pro and Umbrel OS Review – Powerful Home Cloud, Easy Self-Hosting and NAS Caveats - NAS Compares
results.content:
REPLY ON YOUTUBE
24. The UI is heavily cluttered and needs significant UI/UX improvement. More importantly, I have serious concerns about the platform’s production readiness as a NAS. Using an unqualified M.2 SSD for primary NAS storage is a major risk; consumer NVMe drives do not necessarily provide the endurance, power-loss protection, or sustained-write characteristics required for a storage appliance.The software maturity is also concerning. The Umbrel repository currently has hundreds of reported issues, with 380 issues listed and 68 open pull requests. [...] Stability is Rock solid and in my experience it’s very good.

   The backup works flawlessly even with the lack of custom retention you can use to to migrate everything or restore it to a different device as if nothing happened as long as you don’t mount a NFS share as even if you add mounted folder to excluded it Will break the backup.

   Third party store: making your own or using a third-party just does not work also if you add a third-party store it will not allow you to remove it even if the store does not work but will tell you that it already exists. [...] More concerning than the number itself is the nature of some of the open reports: recent issues include server-breaking updates, UI failures, resource leaks, NAS backup problems, and even reports of existing storage being repartitioned/formatted with resulting data loss.
